---
title: "02_summarizing"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(exactextractr)
library(here)

sw_dir  <- here("data", "SurfaceWater")
wet_min <- 0.235
```

```{r}
nwi <- st_read(here("data", "Boundaries", "NWI_SLV.shp")) |>
  st_transform(32613) |>
  mutate(
    nwi_id    = row_number(),
    nwi_ha    = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000,
    system    = substr(ATTRIBUTE, 1, 1),
    regime    = str_extract(ATTRIBUTE, "[A-Z](?=[^A-Z]*$)"),
    impounded = str_detect(ATTRIBUTE, "h"),
    excavated = str_detect(ATTRIBUTE, "x")
  )

nrow(nwi)
sum(nwi$nwi_ha)
table(nwi$regime, useNA = "ifany")
nwi |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(ATTRIBUTE, system, regime, impounded) |>
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
f <- "SurfaceWater2015-2022JUN.tif"
r <- rast(file.path(sw_dir, f))
r

global(r, "notNA")[1, 1] * 0.09
r <- ifel(r >= wet_min, r, NA)
global(r, "notNA")[1, 1] * 0.09
```

```{r}
s <- exact_extract(r, nwi, fun = c("count", "mean"))
head(s)
summary(s)
```

```{r}
test <- nwi |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(nwi_id, ATTRIBUTE, WETLAND_TY, system, regime, impounded, excavated, nwi_ha) |>
  mutate(
    file        = f,
    wet_ha      = s$count * 0.09,
    mean_wet    = s$mean,
    pct_flooded = 100 * wet_ha / nwi_ha
  )

head(test)
```
